lead.headline: BlackRock seeds $100M tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong as Neuberger Berman and Swiss central bank advance institutional onchain infrastructure
lead.tldr: Tokenization of traditional assets is accelerating through multiple institutional entry points—asset managers, banks, and now central banks—while Bitcoin ETF flows signal retail exhaustion and a repricing of crypto-native risk assets.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief tracks institutional money rebuilding financial infrastructure onchain while speculative capital flees the other end of the market.

top_signals.title: BlackRock opens tokenized money market fund with $100 million in assets to Hong Kong investors
top_signals.summary: BlackRock has launched a tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong with $100 million in initial assets. The fund is seeded by Standard Chartered and Ant International and is the first of its kind in the region to offer a constant net asset value.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BlackRock's Hong Kong tokenized money market fund, seeded by Standard Chartered and Ant International, validates tokenized NAV products as a competitive distribution channel for traditional asset managers targeting Asian wealth pools.

top_signals.title: SEC staff gives Molecule no-action relief for scientific research tokens
top_signals.summary: The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance has granted Molecule no-action relief regarding its scientific research tokens. This means the SEC will not recommend charges against the company for these specific digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SEC no-action relief for Molecule's scientific research tokens creates a narrow but usable precedent for utility-linked digital assets that could expand to other RWA and IP-tokenization structures if the Commission maintains this interpretive posture.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs see another $570 million in net outflows as November total nears $5 billion and BTC dips below $60K
top_signals.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced over $570 million in net outflows on Monday. This contributes to a monthly total nearing $5 billion as Bitcoin's price dropped below the $60,000 threshold.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nearly $5 billion in November Bitcoin ETF outflows, with BTC breaking $60K, suggests the post-approval retail bid is exhausting and that crypto-native assets are repricing faster than institutional onchain infrastructure is being built.

top_signals.title: Neuberger Berman's HINC fund brings high-yield credit to Aave's institutional lending platform
top_signals.summary: Neuberger Berman is integrating its HINC high-yield credit fund into Aave's institutional lending platform. This move follows a partnership with Securitize to bring the fund onchain, bridging traditional asset management with DeFi infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Neuberger Berman's HINC fund integration with Aave's institutional platform, via Securitize, demonstrates that traditional fixed-income managers now underwrite DeFi middleware as distribution infrastructure rather than experimental technology.

top_signals.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
top_signals.summary: The Swiss National Bank, UBS, and SIX are collaborating to study the implementation of a shared ledger for the settlement of tokenized assets. The initiative aims to evaluate the efficiency of domestic and cross-border transactions using blockchain technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Swiss National Bank joining UBS and SIX to study tokenized settlement ledgers signals that wholesale CBDC-adjacent infrastructure is moving from research to collaborative prototyping, with implications for euro-area follow-on projects.

deals.summary: Robinhood and Tandem (the venture arm of Offchain) have co-led a $5 million seed funding round for Rialto. Rialto is an onchain trading platform designed to facilitate decentralized asset exchange.

on_the_radar.title: Monad Token Holder Report Q3 2026
on_the_radar.summary: Monad reported significant growth in Q3 2026, doubling both its revenue and transaction volume. The network saw a substantial increase in lending deposits, which tripled to reach $1.49 billion.

on_the_radar.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
on_the_radar.summary: South Korea's financial regulator has proposed a new draft bill to foster crypto innovation while enhancing user protections. The proposal includes the introduction of bank-led stablecoins and a 20% cap on ownership stakes in crypto exchanges.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
on_the_radar.summary: 21Shares analyzes the drivers behind the recent Bitcoin sell-off, attributing the decline to weak demand and forced liquidations. The report highlights a significant contraction in stablecoin supply and ETF outflows as primary catalysts for the bear market pressure.

on_the_radar.title: Coldcard reveals how security reviews missed Bitcoin wallet flaw for over 5 years
on_the_radar.summary: Coinkite has disclosed details regarding a security flaw in the Coldcard Bitcoin wallet that remained undetected for over five years. The company explained how multiple professional security reviews failed to identify the vulnerability during that period.

on_the_radar.title: Kraken's Krak plans early 2027 launch of US credit cards with bitcoin cashback, including one secured by USDC
on_the_radar.summary: Kraken's Krak is planning to launch two Visa Signature credit cards in the US by early 2027. These cards will offer up to 4% cashback in Bitcoin, with one option being secured by USDC.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
on_the_radar.summary: The CFTC has implemented new regulatory rules for prediction markets to standardize trade reporting and user data collection. These changes come as more firms attempt to enter the US market legally.

on_the_radar.title: Rep. Raskin probes Trump Jr.'s firm's investments into Polymarket and Juul over 'suspiciously well-timed government favors'
on_the_radar.summary: Representative Raskin is launching a probe into investments made by Donald Trump Jr.'s firm, specifically targeting holdings in Polymarket and Juul. The investigation focuses on whether these investments were linked to 'suspiciously well-timed government favors'.

on_the_radar.title: What Korea's Draft Digital Asset Basic Act Means for Four Market Groups
on_the_radar.summary: The article discusses South Korea's Draft Digital Asset Basic Act and its potential implications for various market participants. It analyzes how the proposed regulatory framework will impact four specific groups within the digital asset ecosystem.

worth_a_read.title: Monad Token Holder Report Q3 2026
worth_a_read.note: Messari's Monad token holder report offers granular data on validator economics and delegation patterns that any team building or investing in parallel-EVM infrastructure should benchmark against.

linkedin_post:
Robinhood and Tandem just put $5 million into Rialto, an onchain trading platform. That caught our attention less for the size than for the pairing: a retail brokerage with 24 million funded accounts, and the venture arm of the largest cross-chain messaging protocol. They're underwriting the same bet from opposite ends of the stack.

The same day, BlackRock opened a $100 million tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong. Standard Chartered and Ant International seeded it. Neuberger Berman's HINC fund is now on Aave's institutional platform via Securitize. The Swiss National Bank, UBS, and SIX are studying shared ledgers for settlement.

These aren't experiments. They're product launches and infrastructure commitments with named counterparties and regulatory sign-off.

What we're pricing in now: institutional asset flows through tokenized vehicles are becoming the base case, while Bitcoin ETF outflows near $5 billion this month tell a different story about retail risk appetite. The divergence is sharp. Onchain infrastructure is being built for capital that already exists—treasury cash, credit fund allocations, interbank settlement—rather than for speculative position-taking.

Our read: the value is shifting to rails that can custody, price, and settle traditional assets with regulatory clarity. The test is whether tokenized fund AUM compounds faster than crypto-native asset prices recover. If BlackRock's Hong Kong fund scales and the Swiss ledger pilot moves to production, the repricing of infrastructure versus application-layer tokens accelerates.

One open question we can't answer yet: does Aave's institutional platform capture the lending spread, or does Neuberger Berman keep it and treat Aave as plumbing?
